summary: P5 Dashboard reference fidelity compare for alembic-panorama-rebuild. Authority: Design/docs/current/alembic-panorama-rebuild-2026-07-03.md §8/P5 and §12/P5 plus original plan; prior P0-P4 accepted evidence proves data/source/runtime gates, but P5 still requires a reference comparison against the old Panorama UI. Objective: compare the current AlembicDashboard Panorama implementation against the read-only reference snapshot `scratchpad/panorama-reference/frontend/PanoramaView.tsx` (and, only if needed, `git show 0e27445:...` read-only) to confirm old UI fidelity: four tabs overview/dependencies/graph/gaps, overview 6-card stats, architecture pyramid/layer module list, health bar, gaps summary/panel, 14 role labels, and 16 `panorama.*` zh/en i18n keys. Complete definition: 1) produce a traceable per-tab/per-section comparison table listing old reference element, current implementation element/file, pass/deviation, and evidence line/path; 2) verify Dashboard API calls/types still bind to the accepted Alembic P2 endpoints and do not use mock-only compatibility data or fake per-module recipeCount; 3) verify `dependencies` embeds/uses the DepGraphView path and `graph` embeds/uses KnowledgeGraphView per CG-A; 4) verify no old deleted engines/services are resurrected in Dashboard code and no product source outside AlembicDashboard is touched; 5) run relevant Dashboard validation (build:dashboard or repository equivalent, typecheck/api drift/unit tests as available, git diff --check) and optionally a local UI screenshot/smoke if already available without changing providers/data roots; 6) return completed with raw evidence paths, commands, deviations if any, and a clear pass/fail conclusion. If material UI fidelity gaps remain, return blocked with exact missing section/key/label and recommended owner; do not patch backend/Core/Alembic or relax P4 gates. Hard constraints: main only, no push/tag/release/version bump, no checkout/worktree/branch/reset/rebase/cherry-pick; old code reference must be read-only via scratchpad/git show/git archive; do not edit Alembic/AlembicCore/BiliDili/Test/Design; do not delete snapshot tables or touch rescan incremental chain.
designIntent: P5 closes the original UI-completely-preserved principle by comparing the restored Dashboard surface against the old Panorama reference after data/runtime gates have passed.

targetTasks.summary: Compare current AlembicDashboard Panorama UI against the old read-only Panorama reference and return P5 fidelity evidence.
